BEFORE YOU DECIDE
Questions hosts ask
All questions →
Need to move the date?
Reschedule free up to 72 hours before; inside that, it moves to a future date.
Austin heat or a rainy day?
A covered patio or open garage works in rain or heat; if conditions are not safe, we reschedule free.
Do you cook outside Austin?
Yes: Round Rock, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Pflugerville, San Marcos and nearby. Houston and Dallas have their own pages.
An Airbnb or rental house?
Yes, with the host's written permission for outdoor cooking.
A calmer show?
Yes. Choose the level in the request.
